description: Curated application notes for specific tool series. Every entry is taken from the manufacturer's own catalog or product page (url). Notes describe what the manufacturer says the series is designed for; they are not ToolWiz measurements. No prices. Used by toolwiz_common/tooling_advisor.tool_advice.

match_notes.groups: non_ferrous, steel, stainless, ti_ni_co, hardened, cast_iron (same grouping as data/tool_series_performance.json)
match_notes.ops: slot, side, hem, rough, finish, tslot (T-slot and keyseat cutting), tab (tab milling / narrow contour slots)
match_notes.impact: Ranking weight against data-driven gains (a data-driven gain of 1.5 = +50 percent MRR). Higher = listed first.

series.series: Keyseat Cutters, Staggered Tooth, Square, Reduced Shank
series.applies_to: Keyseat and T-slot undercuts in solid carbide where one cutter must cut on both sides of the head
series.why: Staggered alternating right/left shear flutes, and the head is relieved to cut on both sides, so the cutter can be offset to widen the groove and can cut when feeding away from either face (check the part number's neck length against the slot depth).

series.series: HEV-C-5 (5 flute, corner radius, chipbreaker rougher, variable pitch, Tplus)
series.applies_to: High-efficiency milling and roughing in stainless steels, high-temp alloys and hardened steels up to 65 Rc
series.why: Offset chipbreaker geometry on a 5-flute variable-pitch body: the manufacturer lists reduced harmonics and tool pressure and optimal chip evacuation, and names HEM, slotting, plunging and roughing as applications.

series.series: HEV-RN-5 (5 flute, corner radius, variable pitch, reduced neck, Tplus)
series.applies_to: Deep slots, deep pockets and tab-milling contours in ferrous alloys where flute length plus neck must reach past the tool diameter
series.why: Reduced neck keeps strength in long-reach, deep-pocketing cuts, so the tool can reach the slot floor without a full-diameter shank rubbing the walls; 5-flute variable pitch for reduced harmonics.

series.series: End Mills for Hardened Steels, Square, For Steels 45-68 Rc (7 flute, AlTiN Nano)
series.applies_to: Steels 45 to 68 Rc, including stainless, tool and mold steels
series.why: 7 flutes with an approx. 20 degree variable helix for improved material removal rates; the page lists slotting, plunging and roughing. Note: end cutting only, not center cutting.

series.series: Variable Pitch End Mills for Titanium Alloys, Square (6 flute, Ti Nano)
series.applies_to: Heavy radial efficiency milling of Ti-6Al-4V and other titanium alloys
series.why: Variable pitch decreases chatter and harmonics; Ti Nano coating for hardness and heat resistance. The manufacturer states it is not for traditional slotting and roughing toolpaths, so use it with low-engagement toolpaths only.

series.series: High Helix End Mills for Aluminum Alloys, 45 degree Helix, Square (2 and 3 flute)
series.applies_to: Aluminum and other non-ferrous alloys, including small diameters and narrow slots where chip room matters
series.why: 45 degree helix for faster chip removal and better finish with few flutes (more chip room per flute); page lists slotting, plunging, finishing and roughing. Choose uncoated or ZrN/TiB2 for aluminum to resist built-up edge.

series.series: H45AL-RN-3 (3 flute, 45 degree helix, reduced neck, Zplus or uncoated)
series.applies_to: Deep slots, deep pockets and high-efficiency milling in aluminum and non-ferrous materials
series.why: Reduced neck for long reach and deep pocketing with a high-helix 3-flute body; the manufacturer states excellent performance in HEM and accelerated metal removal rates in aluminum.

series.series: End Mills for Aluminum Alloys, Square, Single Flute, Upcut Router
series.applies_to: Aluminum and non-ferrous at high rpm where a single flute leaves the most chip room, such as when the 16,000 rpm spindle limits feed rate
series.why: Single flute with a polished flute to improve chip evacuation and reduce built-up edge; the manufacturer lists optimized geometry for increased material removal rates.

series.series: End Mills for Plastics, Square Upcut, Single Flute
series.why: Large flute valley for chip evacuation, high rake and relief for shearing, a polished flute finish that resists chip welding; the manufacturer states twice the material removal of standard end mills.
